# Javier Borquez

> Postdoctoral Research Associate in the Safe Robotics Lab at Princeton University. PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering from USC. Research focus: safety and control for autonomous systems.

Javier Borquez completed his PhD as the first doctoral graduate of the Safe and Intelligent Autonomy Lab (USC, now at Stanford University), advised by Somil Bansal. He is currently a Postdoctoral Research Associate in the Safe Robotics Lab at Princeton University (https://saferobotics.princeton.edu/).

## Publications

- Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability for Hybrid Systems: Unified Goal-Driven Control with Safety Guarantees. The International Journal of Robotics Research, 2026. https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/02783649261477777
- Timely Activation of Safety Filters via One-Step Reachability Expansion. ICCAR 2026 (Best Oral Presentation). https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/11549591
- DualGuard MPPI - Safe Optimal Control via Sampling MPC and HJ Reachability. IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters, 2025. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10994404
- On Safety and Liveness Filtering Using Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Analysis. IEEE Transactions on Robotics, 2024. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10665911
- Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Analysis for Hybrid Systems with Controlled and Forced Transitions. Robotics: Science and Systems XX, 2024. https://www.roboticsproceedings.org/rss20/p006.html
- Providing Safety Assurances for Systems With Unknown Dynamics. IEEE Control Systems Letters, 2024. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10543106
- Parameter-Conditioned Reachable Sets for Updating Safety Assurances Online. ICRA 2023. https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10160554
